title: Rutz's Traps
description: Players secretly set traps, snares and poisons the GM can't see; when a creature steps on one, the GM gets the details like a used item. The GM can set traps too and peek at the players' traps. Trap DCs scale with level. PF2e and D&D 5e rules built in; works in other systems with generic DCs. — 플레이어가 GM 몰래 함정·덫·독을 깔고, 밟으면 GM에게 세부 내용이 뜹니다. PF2e·D&D 5e 지원.
